headline: Tree removals at 12 Franklin St., tree replacement at 329 Essex St., and future tree plantings on Salem Common.
summary: The agenda covers the Greening the Gateway Cities Program and the Centerboard Project at the Holyoke Ins. Building. It also covers tree permit visibility on the city website, trees and solar panels, and a tree replacement at 329 Essex St.
items: Report from the Tree Warden, Kieran Kavanaugh
Greening the Gateway Cities Program, with David Bresnahan, DCR Forester
Centerboard Project / Holyoke Ins. Building, with Bonnie Henry
Tree permit visibility on city website, including tree removals at 12 Franklin St.
Trees and sustainability, focusing on solar panels
Tree replacement at 329 Essex St., where an elm replaced a hophornbeam under overhead wires
Future tree plantings on Salem Common
Next meeting dates: November 16, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. and December 21, 2026 via Zoom

TREE COMMISSION MEETING NOTICE AND AGENDA 
MONDAY, OCTOBER 19, 2026 AT 7:00 P.M.  
VIA ZOOM 
 
Notice is hereby given that a meeting of the  City of Salem Tree Commission  will be held on 
Monday, October 19, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. via Zoom. The meeting will be accessible via remote 
participation in accordance with Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2025. Every effort will be made to ensure 
that the public can adequately access the proceedings in real time, via technological means. 
 
Pursuant to Section 30A of chapter 20 of the acts of 2021, as amended by 2 section 40 of chapter 2 
of the acts of 2023, and further amended by Section 1 of Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2025, the City is 
authorized to conduct remote meetings of its public bodies through June 30, 2027.  
 
Members of the public and/or parties with a right and/or requirement to attend this meeting may
